title: Writing
intro: Spelling, grammar and punctuation in Russian, Ukrainian, English and Polish, checked on your own server (LanguageTool), and rewrites by the AI when you ask. The browser extension and the desktop app check the same way.

settings.title: How it is checked
settings.noLanguageTool: LanguageTool is not set up on the server (LANGUAGETOOL_URL): only the AI rewrites work.
settings.enabled: Check as I type in the browser extension and the desktop app

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.hint: Words that are right (names, terms): never marked as misspelt.

disabledRules.title: Rules switched off
disabledRules.hint: Added by “Never show this” on a mistake; remove one to see it again.

ignoredSites.title: Sites left alone
ignoredSites.hint: The browser extension does not check on them.

ignoredApps.title: Programs left alone
ignoredApps.hint: The desktop app does not check in them (the name of the process, e.g. code).

errors.check: The check failed: is LanguageTool running?
errors.tooOften: Too many checks a minute: a moment, please.
errors.rewrite: The AI could not rewrite the text.
